what: next/ version. On PR 1037 (P17b slice 1) the shared suite next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/NemesisTest.ts imported four telemetry files (Archive, Records, Sink, Trace). The review answered done and the lead's host checks passed at d9e70aeba, then CI's next job went red at 85a4cf31c on next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/layers.test.ts. The lane went back to the tests step, which moved the telemetry wiring into the driver that node/Nemesis.laws.test.ts passes in. The suite now imports nothing from telemetry/, no layer-rules.json row was added, and CI is green at e231e39f4. One extra round, no person needed.
cause: The layers law skips only files named *.test.ts. A shared suite such as NemesisTest.ts counts as a product file, so the wall 'the runtime may not import data' applies to it, and telemetry is a data module. The runtime's own *.test.ts files import telemetry and pass, which makes the import look allowed. The lead's host run covered only the two changed law files and pnpm lint, and neither runs layers.test.ts.
fix: The lead's host checks for a next/ pull request run next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/layers.test.ts beside the changed test files, before the records commit. The second host run on this pull request did.
test: Replay: check out d9e70aeba and run layers.test.ts alone on the host. It must fail on runtime/NemesisTest.ts, in about 3 seconds.
